description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'BaseMetadataDatatype' which extends 'BaseOpenmrsDatatype'. It serves as a superclass for custom datatypes related to OpenmrsMetadata within the OpenMRS framework, providing a method to generate textual summaries of the data.

classes.name: BaseMetadataDatatype
classes.description: An abstract generic class for custom datatypes that handle OpenmrsMetadata objects, providing a method to produce text summaries.

methods.name: doGetTextSummary
methods.description: Generates a text summary for the typed value, returning the name of the metadata object within a Summary object.
